approval.basis: Founder decision of 2026-11-16: merging this file approves re-activation of Demo WhatsApp for public guests after every Demo deployment, strictly inside these limits and never beyond window_days. Founder decision of 2026-11-27: the same approval covers the Authentication template waooaw_registration_otp, so a registrant can receive one purpose-bound code on request; those codes use the same window, message count, per-minute rate and spend limits.
